blocks.html:
Premium quality Car Wraps in GTA starting from $450

Think it’s time to switch up the look of your vehicle? You’re on the right website! From colour change to customized wraps, Vinyl Wrap Toronto does it all. Because vinyl wraps come in a vast variety of colours, you can change the colour of your vehicle to something truly unique. Car manufacturers usually only release vehicles in a few colours that are acceptable to most people. However, vinyl wraps make it possible for you to change the colour of your vehicle to virtually any colour you can think of. In addition to a large collection of colours, vinyl wraps come in various finishes such as gloss, matte, satin, etc.

If you want to go beyond just changing colour, we can design a custom wrap to make your vehicle one of a kind. Imagine stepping out of a car wrapped in your favourite design.

Over the years we have wrapped cars including but not limited to:

  • Tesla
  • Ford
  • Mustang
  • Audi
  • Hyundai
  • Nissan
  • KIA
  • Jeep
  • RAM
  • Honda

Car Wrap FAQs

1) How long does the car vinyl wrap last?

With the right material and maintenance, vinyl wraps can last from 5 to 7 years.

2) How much does it cost to wrap a car?

Depending on the type of wrap and complexity, the cost can vary. Give us a call for an accurate quote.

3) How long does it take to wrap a car?

It can take anywhere between 1 to 5 days depending on the type and complexity of the job.

If you have any questions or concerns about wrapping, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts.

Have a question about the car vinyl wrap cost? Send us a message and our team will get back to you with an estimated car wrapping price.

View our portfolio here. To read more articles, visit our blog page.
